title: Limiting and finite Fourier tail comparison
statement: Let $n$ and $k$ be natural numbers such that $n$ and $k$ are odd and $2k^2\le n$. The limiting majority Fourier weight above level $k$, minus the Fourier weight above level $k$ of the majority function on the $n$-dimensional Boolean cube, lies between $0$ and $4(2/\pi)^{3/2}k^{-3/2}$.
